title: Corrective-action overdue rate
summary: Share of open corrective actions on the post-incident-review corrective-action register that are past their due date at the end of the reporting window. Tracks the under-execution risk on lessons-learned follow-through. Lower is better; counterpart KRI to the close-rate KPI on the same register.

target.rationale: Programme risk threshold; supports NIS2 Art. 21(2)(b) effectiveness signalling.

measurement.formula: count( actions where status=='open' AND now() > due_date ) / count( actions where status=='open' )

inputs.name: register
inputs.description: operator-owned corrective-action register read at window close
